evidence.title: Treasurer Tops Out Macquarie Data Centres' Newest 47MW AI and Cloud Data Centre
evidence.excerpt: Macquarie reports completion of IC3 Super West's external structure, identifies a 47 MW end-state facility, and says Phase 1 will deliver the complete core and shell with 6 MW IT load fitted out.
